# b2b-ai-mcp-skills (`ttyan0111` / `truonggiang0111`)

> Zero-proxy B2B Hiring Intelligence, Public Tenders, ClinicalTrials Biotech Leads, Competitor Ad Spend Spy, Multi-Store Review Churn Spy & Google News Real-URL RAG tools (`15` Agent Skills, `16` `n8n` Workflows, `n8n` Community Node `18` Ops, `100` AI `.md` Tasks, `16` Live Agensi Skills + `3` Bundles, Node STDIO MCP + Python SDK + Sample Datasets).
> Hosted serverless on Apify (`$5/month` free credit included) and distributed on Agensi.io (`https://mcp.agensi.io/mcp/auth`).
> Full single-file spec: [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/truonggiang0111/b2b-ai-mcp-skills/main/llms-full.txt)

## Remote MCP Endpoints (All-in-One B2B Suite)

- URL (`streamable-http`, Apify): `https://mcp.apify.com?actors=ttyan0111/reed-uk-jobs-hiring-signals,ttyan0111/seek-au-nz-jobs-hiring-signals,ttyan0111/app-store-play-reviews-spy,ttyan0111/google-ads-transparency-spy,ttyan0111/google-news-ai-article-extractor,ttyan0111/substack-newsletter-creator-leads,ttyan0111/chrome-web-store-extension-spy,ttyan0111/shopify-app-store-churn-spy,ttyan0111/podcast-host-email-sponsor-spy,ttyan0111/vscode-cursor-extension-spy`
- Zero-Key Managed Marketplace (Agensi MCP `https://mcp.agensi.io/mcp/auth`): `https://www.agensi.io/creators/giang-tr-ng-tr-ng`
- Official MCP Registry Namespaces (`io.github.truonggiang0111/*` — `11` Servers / `12` Active Versions):
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/reed-uk-jobs-mcp`: Reed.co.uk UK jobs & Direct-Employer (`direct=True`) + Outside IR35 flags (`https://apify.com/ttyan0111/reed-uk-jobs-hiring-signals`)
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/seek-au-nz-jobs-mcp`: Seek Australia (`seek.com.au`) & New Zealand (`seek.co.nz`) GraphQL jobs + company signals without HTML 403 blocks (`https://apify.com/ttyan0111/seek-au-nz-jobs-hiring-signals`)
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/app-reviews-bug-spy-mcp`: Unified iOS App Store + Google Play reviews with server-side star filter & pain-signal tags (`https://apify.com/ttyan0111/app-store-play-reviews-spy`)
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/google-ads-transparency-mcp`: Google Ads Transparency Center creatives, active days & EU DSA reach stats (`https://apify.com/ttyan0111/google-ads-transparency-spy`)
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/google-news-real-url-mcp`: Decode opaque `news.google.com/rss` links into real destination publisher URLs (`url` + `urlDecoded`) + clean LLM/RAG full article text (`https://apify.com/ttyan0111/google-news-ai-article-extractor`)
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/substack-creator-leads-mcp`: Substack Newsletter & Creator Email Leads (`https://apify.com/ttyan0111/substack-newsletter-creator-leads`, `servers/substack-leads/server.json`)
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/chrome-web-store-spy-mcp`: Chrome Web Store Extensions, Dev Emails & Reviews Spy (`https://apify.com/ttyan0111/chrome-web-store-extension-spy`, `servers/chrome-store-spy/server.json`)
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/shopify-app-store-churn-mcp`: Shopify App Store 1-Star Churn & Dev Emails Spy (`https://apify.com/ttyan0111/shopify-app-store-churn-spy`, `servers/shopify-app-spy/server.json`)
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/podcast-host-email-mcp`: Apple Podcasts Host Emails & Sponsor Leads (`https://apify.com/ttyan0111/podcast-host-email-sponsor-spy`, `servers/podcast-email-spy/server.json`)
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/vscode-cursor-extension-mcp`: VS Code & Open-VSX (Cursor/Windsurf) Extension Spy (`https://apify.com/ttyan0111/vscode-cursor-extension-spy`, `servers/vscode-extension-spy/server.json`)
  - `io.github.truonggiang0111/b2b-market-intel-mcp`: Multi-tool B2B Market Intel suite combining all 10 live endpoints above (`v1.1.0`)
